_about: A stored scan below the confidence threshold (65% by default), read by BOTH test suites: msas-system/tests/Feature/CanonicalDiagnosisParityTest.php (API subset, web history, PDF report) and mobile/app/diagnosis/__tests__/lowConfidenceParity.test.js (app result screen). Neither side may present it as one diagnosis: both show the inconclusive headline, at most three possible causes in plain words, health 'Needs checking', no severity or urgency, 'What to do now', the retake button, the confirm-with-an-expert message and the AI disclaimer.
